| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | Markup rendered as the tab label instead of Label. A link tab navigates rather than owning a panel, so its label is the whole of what it renders and content written between the tags binds here. |

| `Match` | `NavMatchMode` | `NavMatchMode.Prefix` | Parameter |  | Route matching strategy used to derive the active state - prefix or exact. Default Prefix. |
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback` | `` | Callback |  | Invoked when the tab is clicked, before navigation would occur. When set, the default navigation is suppressed (mirrors OnClick) so the handler can decide whether/how to navigate. |
| `Tooltip` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Tooltip text shown on hover/focus of the tab (native title). |
